verdict.reasons: The image shows the correct AFP drip-tape carton roll with the required 'AFP | 09134922013' watermark and authentic 'Drip Irrigation Tape' branding. However, the image fails the 'minimum overall quality score of 90 out of 100' threshold and multiple core conditions. The white tape from the carton is physically fused to the metal fitting of the pressure gauge, implying the tape is the pipe being measured, which is technically incorrect; the gauge should be attached to the header line. The black irrigation pipe appears to emerge from the bottom of the gauge, creating an implausible physical connection. Furthermore, the product is not integrated into a functioning irrigation system as the white tape is just lying down. The minor imperfections (gauge scale readability) are advisory, but the impossible geometry and packaging hardware issue are core defects.
